title: Fix LLM API 429 Rate Limit Errors with One curl Flag
description:
Your AI app crashes on 429 errors? One flag fixes it. 🔁

✅ Add --retry 5 to your curl call
✅ It waits longer after each failure
✅ It also obeys the server's retry-after

Day 5 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 6, Track Token Spend per Request.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

#shorts #ai #coding #api #programming #tutorial #llm
comment: Curl or Python: which would you retry in? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: curl --retry-delay sets a fixed wait, which turns off the growing backoff.
